title: Torsion etale cohomology over a proper w-contractible closed fibre
statement: Let R be a w-contractible commutative ring [sk-def-pe-wlocal], J its Jacobson radical, i:Spec(R/J) -> Spec R the quotient immersion. Let p:T -> Spec R be proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and (t:T0 -> T,p0:T0 -> Spec(R/J)) a cartesian square over i. For every torsion abelian etale sheaf F on T and every q>=0, the canonical pullback Etale.cohomologyMap t F q is bijective [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback].

proof.text: The Jacobson radical J of a w-contractible ring R forms a henselian pair (R,J), including when R is zero. Apply the Jacobson-henselian theorem; its first clause supplies the required HenselianRing instance.

proof.text: Put K=F[0]. The torsion characterization identifies IsTorsionAbelianSheaf F with local torsion of F. In degree zero the canonical single/homology isomorphism transports this property to H^0(K); in every other degree the homology is zero, so its sections are killed by 1. Thus K has torsion etale cohomology. Apply proper henselian derived restriction to p and K to obtain invertibility of the actual canonical derived restriction along the chosen closed-fibre projection j.

proof.text: The derived-unit formula identifies this derived restriction with RΓ of the adjunction unit followed by Leray. Apply degree-q homology, which preserves isomorphisms. The existing additive equivalences between derived global homology of F[0] and Ext sheaf cohomology identify its map exactly with cohomologyMap j F q; bijectivity transfers through these two equivalences.

proof.text: The given cartesian square supplies e:T0 ≅ pullback p i with e.hom ≫ j = t. Topological invariance for the isomorphism e.hom and the preceding step make successive pullback along j and e.hom bijective. Cohomology pullback functoriality identifies this composite with cohomologyMap (e.hom ≫ j) up to the isomorphism on cohomology induced by the inverse-image compositor. Cancel that isomorphism and rewrite e.hom ≫ j = t.

lean.statement:
theorem proper_wContractible_torsion_rigidity
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsWContractibleRing R]
    {T T₀ : Scheme.{u}} (p : T ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) [IsProper p]
    (t : T₀ ⟶ T)
    (p₀ : T₀ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R))))
    (sq : IsPullback t p₀ p
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.jacobson (⊥ : Ideal R))))))
    (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology Ab.{u + 1}) (hF : Scheme.IsTorsionAbelianSheaf F)
    (q : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (cohomologyMap t F q)
